notes.title: The Asskickers "Game at Home" sale
notes.notes:
Dear Asskickers, 

Now is the time to stay at home to protect yourself, your loved ones as well as society as a whole. 

It is the perfect time to play video games to keep you entertained and in good spirits.

To fight against boredom while keeping your spirits high, nothing beats a good video game. 

We are therefore pleased to offer a 90% discount on The Asskickers for a period of two-week,starting today, as part of a special "Game at Home" sale. 

In the Asskickers, join Alex, Diane and Marcus in their action-packed journey through the heart of the modern urban jungles. Wrongly accused, our three heroes will stand up to a corrupt political and financial elite and make white-collar criminals discover the lost art of asskicking.

As the whole world is facing this serious crisis, now is the perfect time to kick the ass of those who through incompetence, corruption or greed made it possible.

 Gifting a game to your friends is also a nice gesture to show your support and cheer them up! 

So get The Asskickers for less than $1 today and get some asskicking done!

Take care and stay strong!
The AK team

notes.title: Steam Cloud support added
notes.notes:
We are happy to inform you that The Asskickers now supports Steam cloud saving system. This will allow you to store your saves in the cloud and easily retrieve them.

Keep on kicking ass.
The Asskickers Support Team
